items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We've got a picture from the Hambone Inn. It says, it's you on saxophone, F.J. Curley-Lazana. And there's a clarinet in the picture, too. That's his.

ctx.x: Well, he played the Morrison's during the Depression. Probably had gone back to Morrison's after these other engagements. He didn't pick up with his music again until these Willis Fall bands came together.
We've got a picture from the Hambone Inn. It says, it's you on saxophone, F.J. Curley-Lazana. And there's a clarinet in the picture, too. That's his. And one of the guitar players is named Bobby.

Yeah, that was Bobby. We showed it to you a long time ago. We didn't get Bobby's last name. We didn't get the other guitar player. Didn't get his last name? Dan Seals, who was the owner of the Hambone Possible. Seals, the owner. He played an officer, too. He was the owner. He was a bass player. Yeah, he played bass and he played guitar, too. Yeah. Dan played bass and guitar. And what's the most?
